source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: When should you define the required qualities of an output in a skill evaluation?

options.text: After choosing the output that looks most impressive
options.feedback: Choosing standards after seeing a preferred result can reward appearance instead of the intended task requirements.

options.text: After the skill has been running unattended for several weeks
options.feedback: You need success criteria during development, before relying on repeated unattended operation.

options.text: Before judging the outputs from the evaluation
options.feedback: Advance criteria give you a stable basis for inspecting results and deciding whether the skill helps.

options.text: After a user reports a failure in the deployed procedure
options.feedback: Reported failures can improve later tests, but initial evaluation also needs explicit success criteria.
